dialect.detail: IBM mainframe COBOL with DB2 embedded SQL (EXEC SQL), DSNTIAR error handling, IBM-370 source/object computer, RECORDING MODE IS F, COMP and COMP usage - consistent with IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS. Program appears to be part of a BNSF (Burlington Northern Santa Fe railroad) customer/location master data system.
evidence: DSNTIAR referenced for DB2 error handling

purpose.domain_detail: BNSF (Burlington Northern Santa Fe) railroad freight/logistics - customer location master data management. The program processes address records merged into the BNSF master and calls subprogram CLCSLALM to find existing locations for potential merges.
purpose.summary: Batch program CLADRILD pulls all address records merged into the BNSF master and sends them to subprogram CLCSLALM to look for existing locations to merge with. It runs regularly to identify potential location merges as new addresses are created, and produces an output report with counts and results.

notable_features: 88-level condition names for DB2 return codes
Physical and mailing address fields in copybook
